INCOME_LOW.applicant: Your income is low relative to the amount you requested

LOAN_AMOUNT_HIGH.applicant: The loan amount requested is high relative to your income

LTV_HIGH.applicant: The loan amount is high relative to the value of the property, leaving limited equity

DTI_HIGH.applicant: Your total monthly debt payments are high relative to your monthly income

TERM_UNFAVOURABLE.applicant: The repayment term requested is outside the range typically approved

INTEREST_ONLY.applicant: The loan requested has an interest-only period, which defers repayment of the principal balance

BALLOON_PAYMENT.applicant: The loan requested includes a balloon payment, which concentrates repayment at the end of the term

NEG_AMORTIZATION.applicant: The loan requested allows the balance owed to increase over time

AREA_INCOME_LOW.applicant: Economic indicators for the area in which the property is located

PROPERTY_UNITS.applicant: The number of units in the property securing the loan

NO_PREAPPROVAL.applicant: No preapproval was requested for this application
